basics.summary: Bioinformatics research scientist with over 2 years full-time equivalent experience. Specializes in bridging the gap between bioinformatics and software engineering, with broad proficiencies in biological wet lab research in pathology/immunology.

highlights: Epic EHR system for recording patient data and communicating with providers
Excelled at communicating disease and medical treatment biology to non-technically oriented patients.

work.name: Burberry Lab, CWRU Department of Pathology
work.summary: Starting as an undergraduate and graduating to a full-time position, I specialized in bioinformatics while maintaining deep involvement in hands-on benchtop lab work.
highlights: Led the lab’s computational biology development, including configuring AWS resources, packaging stable implementations of core software, and developing next-generation sequencing analysis pipelines.
Spearheaded analysis of single cell RNA sequencing in R, and 16S gut microbial sequencing in Python with Nextflow.
Designed exploratory analysis of Alzheimer's Disease patient sample data via applications of graph data science to the Reactome database and scikit-learn predictive analysis methods.
Managed multiple undergraduate students in a collaborative project, fostering good lab practices and communication.

Supported mouse model research, performing drug administration via IP injection and oral gavage, probiotic administration, behavioral testing, mouse husbandry, and dissections for ex vivo tissue collection.

highlights: Taught a class of 20 students weekly, focusing on translating theory into actionable problem-solving skills.
Delivered detailed explanations in office hours and detailed feedback on assignments for students needing support, reframing and communicating key concepts to a diverse array of student needs.

Designed DNA plasmids and restriction enzyme screening protocols for recombinant protein synthesis with E. coli.
